summary: Tested Founding Member badge data-flow, new GET /api/admin/users endpoint, and the 'All Users' admin screen. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases passed (admin/users 401/403/200 gating + field shape, founding-member flag mutated directly via Mongo mirroring a real Stripe activation -> flows correctly through author_summary() into POST /api/posts response, GET /api/posts/{id}, GET /api/posts feed, GET /api/users/{id}, and GET /api/admin/users; billing regression: /membership, /billing/checkout-link, /billing/portal, /stripe/webhook signature check all unchanged). Frontend: logged in as admin (shanelle120@gmail.com) - Home feed screenshot visually confirms an amber/gold trophy icon renders immediately next to 'Founder Test' author name in the post header, while the adjacent 'Regular Test' post (no is_founding_member) shows no icon - exactly matching the testID pattern post-founder-badge-<post_id>. Profile > settings gear > ADMIN section shows both 'Billing Waitlist' and 'All Users' links for admin only (both absent for demo@leveluphub.com, confirmed via testID count=0). /admin/users screen loads with '154 accounts total', live search filtering works (typed 'demo' -> 5 rows matching name/username/email substring; typed 'founder' -> 1 row, the trophy+PREMIUM pill correctly shown on Founder Test row, absent on Regular Test row). Direct navigation to /admin/users as non-admin (demo account) correctly shows the 'Admin access required' empty state instead of the list.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_activity.py GET /admin/users correctly reuses require_admin dependency, projects only needed fields, caps at 1000 docs, and shapes output with explicit bool()/isoformat() coercions - clean and consistent with existing admin/billing-waitlist endpoint style.
core.py author_summary()/public_user() cleanly add is_founding_member with bool() coercion so it's never None/undefined in the API contract that post-card.tsx and admin/users.tsx rely on.

routes_billing.py _set_subscription() correctly preserves the original `since` timestamp across repeat webhook events (read-then-conditionally-set pattern) and only sets is_founding_member when not already true and since <= cutoff - matches the one-way/non-revocable design intent; not independently re-verified here per agent-to-agent note (already verified out-of-band by main agent with monkeypatched Stripe SDK).

post-card.tsx founderBadge renders in the same header row/slot as the Mingle tag and trading-style tag as specified, with its own testID pattern post-founder-badge-<post_id>; visually confirmed via screenshot.

admin/users.tsx client-side search (useMemo filter over display_name/username/email, case-insensitive substring) works correctly and is appropriately gated by isAdmin before firing the query (enabled: isAdmin).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all manual UI/integration checks passed: admin profile menu shows both admin links, non-admin sees neither, admin/users list+search+founder trophy+admin shield rendering, non-admin direct-nav empty state, feed trophy badge visible on founder post and absent on regular post)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_founder_<hex>@example.com (mutated is_founding_member=true, membership.tier=premium directly via Mongo to simulate a real pre-cutoff Stripe activation) and TEST_regular_<hex>@example.com via signup, plus one post each ('TEST_founder_post hello traders' / 'TEST_regular_post hello traders') for badge visual verification. Test data left in place (harmless, prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Founding-member webhook internal logic (cutoff comparison, since-preservation across repeat events, non-revocation on cancellation) was already independently verified by main agent out-of-band per the agent-to-agent context note and was NOT re-verified here - only the API-level data flow (user.is_founding_member -> author_summary -> post response -> UI trophy icon) and the new admin/users screen were tested, both pass. No real Stripe payment was attempted.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found this iteration.
